purpose: Decorative backdrop for the compact Ask Mosaic invitation beside Shop search. Text and button remain live UI elements.
reference_role: Visual style only; no product identity or product imagery is reused in the banner.
prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a new premium web UI background asset, landscape 2:1, at least 2048 x 1024. The supplied monitor photo is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: translate the flowing champagne, bronze and burgundy curves visible on its display into a close-up photograph of plush velvet drapery. Do not include a monitor, desk, room, objects, text, typography, logos, borders or buttons. Fill the frame with tactile, fine-pile velvet fabric in a few broad, soft, sculptural folds. Quiet luminous champagne/oat velvet covers the LEFT TWO THIRDS with very gentle tonal changes, sufficiently light and uncluttered for a short dark burgundy heading and a button to be overlaid later in code. Deeper burgundy and warm bronze velvet folds sweep across the RIGHT THIRD and curl along the lower-right edge, echoing the monitor wallpaper's elegant wave. Soft afternoon side-light, subtle satin-like sheen on the velvet's rounded folds, deep rich shadows only on the far right, photographic microtexture, luxurious but restrained. This will be a SMALL invitation card around 292 x 132 CSS pixels beside a search input, so use large simple flowing folds and clear left negative space that remain beautiful at small size. Entire image edge-to-edge fabric, no writing of any kind.
